facts.claim_text: Obtain a bedside transthoracic echocardiogram to evaluate cardiac function given elevated BNP and persistent hypertension.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The BNP measurement of 4079 pg/mL is markedly above the normal reference range, directly supporting the statement that BNP is elevated.

facts.text: Hourly point-of-care glucose monitoring is currently being performed.
facts.label: not_supported
facts.reason: The records show glucose finger sticks at 20:59 and 01:21, but no glucose measurement at the decision time of 21:00 and no order or documentation of hourly point-of-care glucose monitoring. The available measurements do not demonstrate that hourly monitoring is currently being performed.
